programmes.d: Hapless drifters Frank and Bruno team up with a woman to recover her land and trek across 1870s southern Arizona to find an elusive frontier musician.

The Viking Society is recruiting volunteers for the first manned mission to Mars. David, a high school gym teacher, seizes an opportunity to revive his dream of becoming an astronaut and making a difference.
Dr. Who (Peter Cushing), his granddaughter, his niece and a London bobby (Bernard Cribbins) find that Daleks have invaded 22nd-century Earth and are turning humans into slaves.
Nekron and his mother, Queen Juliana, attack humans using huge glaciers. When Larn's village is destroyed, he sets out to rescue Princess Teegra with Darkwolf.
An alien-thing stalks corporate rivals from U.S. and German spaceships on one of Saturn's moons.
Apprentices at a martial arts school are suspicious of two outsiders.

White Dragon must get a list with the names of rebel supporters to Prince Ma Tang, the leader of the rebellion. Trying to stop him in his mission is the evil prime minister, who naturally wants the list so he can crush his opposition.

Four fallen gods are responsible for the environmental disaster that engulfs their land. When a human accidentally takes one of the god's powers, he must train to be one of them, either to become their savior or to bring about their ultimate doom.
Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.
A drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers.

Heaven punishes eight gods for incessant fighting by sending them into the secular world, only able to return once they make accords. Ten thousand years later, a Hong Kong family meets several eccentric people when fleeing from debt collectors.
